title: To save space, switch from rows to columns (and vice versa) on a panel with enough thickness
line: On thick panels the Color Picker now arranges its buttons in several rows or columns instead of showing a few giant icons.
explanation: The Color Picker's compact representation always laid out the picker button and the saved-color buttons in one row (horizontal panel) or one column (vertical panel), with every button as big as the panel is thick. On a thick panel this gives huge icons and wastes space, as the reporter and Kai Uwe noted. The layout now uses as many rows (or columns on vertical panels) as fit buttons at least a medium icon plus spacing in size, up to the number of buttons; the separator line is hidden when it wraps. Normal panel sizes (below about 80 px) keep the single-line layout.

commits.message:
applets/colorpicker: wrap buttons into several rows on thick panels

On a thick panel the picker and color buttons stayed in a single row or
column and grew to the full thickness, wasting a lot of space. Lay them
out in as many rows or columns as fit buttons of a medium icon size.

BUG: 356604

patches.diff:
From 0608bba3a827adbf5533bf907a13c22596bc3a92 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:14:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/colorpicker: wrap buttons into several rows on thick
 panels

On a thick panel the picker and color buttons stayed in a single row or
column and grew to the full thickness, wasting a lot of space. Lay them
out in as many rows or columns as fit buttons of a medium icon size.

BUG: 356604
---
 applets/colorpicker/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml | 14 +++++++++-----
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/colorpicker/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/colorpicker/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 1e71ff103..f4914a508 100644
--- a/applets/colorpicker/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/colorpicker/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -38,7 +38,10 @@ DropArea {
     Layout.maximumWidth: height * (2 + Plasmoid.configuration.compactPreviewCount)
     Layout.maximumHeight: width * (2 + Plasmoid.configuration.compactPreviewCount)
 
-    readonly property real buttonSize: isVertical ? parent.width : parent.height
+    readonly property real thickness: isVertical ? parent.width : parent.height
+    readonly property int lines: Math.max(1, Math.min(1 + Plasmoid.configuration.compactPreviewCount,
+                                                      Math.floor(thickness / (Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2))))
+    readonly property real buttonSize: thickness / lines
     property bool containsAcceptableDrag: false
 
 
@@ -89,8 +92,9 @@ DropArea {
 
         anchors.fill: parent
 
-        columns: dropArea.isVertical ? 1 : (1 + (circleRepeater.count > 0 ? circleRepeater.count + 1 : 0))
-        rows: dropArea.isVertical ? (1 + (circleRepeater.count > 0 ? circleRepeater.count + 1 : 0)) : 1
+        flow: dropArea.isVertical ? GridLayout.LeftToRight : GridLayout.TopToBottom
+        columns: dropArea.lines
+        rows: dropArea.lines
         rowSpacing: 0
         columnSpacing: 0
 
@@ -132,7 +136,7 @@ DropArea {
             Layout.preferredWidth: dropArea.isVertical ? parent.width : thickness
             Layout.preferredHeight: dropArea.isVertical ? thickness : parent.height
             Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
-            visible: circleRepeater.count > 0
+            visible: circleRepeater.count > 0 && dropArea.lines === 1
 
             Rectangle {
                 anchors.centerIn: parent
@@ -154,7 +158,7 @@ DropArea {
                 Layout.preferredWidth: dropArea.buttonSize
                 Layout.preferredHeight: dropArea.buttonSize
 
-                Layout.maximumWidth: (root.width - pickColorButton.width - spacer.width) / Plasmoid.configuration.compactPreviewCount
+                Layout.maximumWidth: dropArea.lines > 1 ? dropArea.buttonSize : (root.width - pickColorButton.width - spacer.width) / Plasmoid.configuration.compactPreviewCount
                 Layout.maximumHeight: Layout.maximumWidth
                 Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
                 color: dropArea.historyModel.count > index ? dropArea.historyModel.get(index).color : "#00000000" // transparent as fallback
--

reviews.text: Clean, minimal QML fix in Color Picker's CompactRepresentation that automatically wraps the picker and saved-color buttons into multiple rows or columns on thick panels using a sensible medium-icon threshold, matching System Tray behavior without adding unnecessary settings. The GridLayout flow/columns/rows setup works for arbitrary item counts in both orientations, hides the separator when wrapped, and fixes ColorCircle's maximumWidth so circles do not collapse in multi-row layouts. Before/after screenshots clearly verify both horizontal and vertical thick panels, and the commit message and BUG tag are accurate.
